races.paceDynamic: Style Of Life, Montezin and Highland Olly will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three having natural front-running tendencies and recent form suggesting they'll contest the early lead. The pace will be genuine throughout this 7f trip, testing stamina reserves in the final two furlongs. With 9 runners wanting prominent positions behind the leaders, there's significant congestion danger approaching the home turn. This genuine pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early traffic and finish fastest when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and fade from 2f out
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Patient rides on classy horses with tactical speed prove decisive when the pace falls apart.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets soft fractions by going clear early
scenarios.body: Highland Olly or Style Of Life could steal a march if the other front-runners let them dictate, maintaining enough energy to resist late challengers. The prominent runners get first run but can't catch the survivor.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but sustainable allowing prominent horses to strike 3f out
scenarios.body: Zarathos and Harry The Rogue get perfect positions behind the leaders and have enough class to quicken clear when the pace lifts. They avoid traffic problems while still getting into contention early enough.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If moderate early fractions lead to a bunched field turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace means the entire field arrives together with 2f to run, creating a cavalry charge finish. Sprint speed rather than stamina becomes the key factor in a messy conclusion.

races.paceDynamic: Fashion People and Lilt will dispute the early lead in this small field, with both confirmed front runners likely to go forward from the start. The honest gallop they create will stretch the field over York's stiff mile, putting pressure on the hold-up horses to get into contention earlier than ideal. With Pacific Mission and So Regal sitting prominent behind the leaders, the pace should be solid throughout. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical pace, as the small field and dual pace angle will create a searching test that punishes pure hold-up merchants.

scenarios.trigger: If the dual pace angle creates honest fractions without collapsing
scenarios.body: The searching gallop will find out the pure hold-up horses, allowing those with tactical speed to strike approaching the final furlong. Pacific Mission and So Regal are perfectly positioned to capitalize on this race shape.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is surprisingly strong and the leaders come back significantly
scenarios.body: Botagoz and Act Of Kindness would need the front pair to go too fast early to have realistic chances from their hold-up styles. The small field makes this scenario less likely but not impossible.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a sprint from halfway due to modest early fractions
scenarios.body: So Regal's proven turn of foot would be decisive if the race develops into a tactical affair with a sprint finish. Her recent Goodwood form suggests she has the class edge in a slowly-run contest.

races.paceDynamic: Altareq is the sole confirmed front-runner but faces immediate pressure from seven prominent racers including Warrant Holder, Thunder Run, Ashnak, Castle Stuart, and Double Parked all wanting that early position. This congestion will create a falsely-run pace through the first half-mile as they jostle for position, before the real pace kicks in from 3f out when the field compresses. The tactical crunch comes 2-3f out when the prominent pack meets the closing hold-up horses on this stamina-testing 1m2½f trip. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver their challenge late.

scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion leads to overly cautious early fractions with nobody wanting to commit
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best turn of foot prevails rather than stamina, suiting horses with sharp acceleration over stayers. Fresh legs and class tell.
